summary.headline: Coforge Q1 FY27 consolidated reported EBIT margin 16.0% with Encora (two months), revenue US$592.2M, up 49% YoY.
summary.overview: Q1 FY27 includes two months of Encora (US$100.7M revenue). Reported revenue was US$592.2M (₹55,277 million), and organic CC sequential growth was 1.1% reported, or 5.2% excluding the India government business and data center exits. Consolidated EBIT margin was 16.0% (organic 16.7%), and FCF was US$52.9M (95.3% FCF-to-PAT). Order intake was US$691M from four large deals (organic only) and the 12-month executable order book reached an all-time high of US$2.23B, up 44.2% YoY. Management reaffirmed FY27 guidance and said Q2 should be robust with large deals ramping mainly from Q3.

guidance_outlook: FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin guided at 20.5% to 21%, unchanged.
FY27 standalone EBIT margin guided at 16.5% to 17%; consolidated EBIT at 15.5% or higher, with management saying it expects to surpass 15.5%.
FY27 FCF-to-PAT guided at 100% or more.
EPS accretion on track for FY27 per management.
Q2 expected to be a robust growth quarter; most large-deal revenue impact from Q3 onwards. No hard QoQ revenue guidance given.
Encora G&A to improve further in Q2 with full-quarter effect; marginal integration costs in Q2, none from Q3.
Wage hikes: limited to a select group in Q1; broad hikes not expected before Q4 and uncertain.
capex_capacity: Encora integration: all 45 legal entities migrated to SAP S/4HANA effective May 1; revenue recognition, planning and performance management processes aligned.

Financing: US$550M three-year term loan fully drawn as of June 30; fixed post-tax cost 2.99% (4.6% pre-tax) with repayments of ~US$59M in FY27, ~US$209M in FY28, ~US$258M in FY29 and ~US$75M in Q1 FY30.

Purchase accounting: ~US$480M customer relationship intangibles amortised over 12 years (~US$40M per year); goodwill recognised at ₹120,890 million per BSE filing (the presentation figure of ₹142,651 million was disputed by an analyst).
Acquisition share value at closing INR 1,220 per share vs INR 1,815 at signing, reducing goodwill by ~US$600M.
AI investment: ~US$58M in AI innovation in FY26; 11,000+ data and AI practitioners, 8 AI platforms, 22 AI assets, 100+ reusable agents; ~30% of active engagements use AI in delivery.
demand_pricing: Order intake US$691M in Q1 from four large deals; this is organic only and excludes Encora order intake, which management did not quantify.
Next-12-month executable order book US$2.23B, up 44.2% YoY from US$1.55B.
Management expects Q2 large-deal signings near what was signed in a full year 2-3 years ago; a US$230M-plus five-year European AI-led transformation deal was signed in Q2 (not in Q1 order intake).
Outcome-based contracts are 6-7% of global run-rate revenue; management said solution-led selling does not warrant price discounting.
Industry deflation from AI efficiency is acknowledged, offset by legacy modernisation, AI-ready data, cloud and security demand.

qa_highlights.question: Mix of order intake between Encora and core business; does it include the UK framework agreements?
qa_highlights.answer: US$691M is organic only (ex-Encora). UK framework agreements are still not included and will sit on top of announced order intake.

qa_highlights.question: Why did net working capital rise in absolute and % of sales?
qa_highlights.answer: Absolute increase reflects Encora consolidation; working capital days have come down.

qa_highlights.question: Monetisation of Nuuron, Mod Squads and FDEs; T&M vs fixed price mix; impact of giving up 100bps of margin for growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Nuuron is an operating layer, not a platform; ~30% of active projects use AI assets, and no standalone AI revenue number is given. Outcome-based contracts are 6-7% of run-rate revenue. Management will not trade price for growth and targets both highest growth and highest margin among mid-caps.

qa_highlights.question: Why did G&A people cost rise faster than revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Absolute G&A rose only because Encora was consolidated; combined G&A is 6.6% of revenue, down from 10% Encora standalone, a ~40% cut.

qa_highlights.question: Rest of World margin flat despite exits; cloud revenue moderating; goodwill reconciliation?
qa_highlights.answer: Exits of high-margin India government and data center business held RoW margin flat; Encora consolidation also contributed. Cloud grew ~4% QoQ; percentage share fell as Encora was almost entirely engineering. Goodwill per BSE filing is ₹120,890 million.

qa_highlights.question: Ramp-up status of the US$158M and US$230M deals; wage hikes; whether 5% QoQ CC growth continues.
qa_highlights.answer: First deal ramp is complete with 300+ FTEs across 15-20 teams; second deal ramp started, adding 20-30 teams. Broad wage hikes not before Q4 and uncertain. No hard QoQ revenue guidance given.

qa_highlights.question: Encora revenue strategy and large-account opportunities?
qa_highlights.answer: One Encora-sourced account is in the top 10 and could reach US$50M+ over 12-18 months; two accounts are in the 11-20 band. Hi-Tech vertical added and healthcare nearly doubled.

qa_highlights.question: India government run-rate reduction of US$35M remaining; outcome-based pricing examples?
qa_highlights.answer: The reduction is already in the base, so no incremental impact is expected. Outcome models include risk-based legacy modernisation, monthly subscription Mod Squads and tech- or business-linked outcome pricing.

qa_highlights.question: Encora order intake trajectory and time to match Coforge intensity?
qa_highlights.answer: Encora order intake was described as robust but not quantified; management expects margins to be indistinguishable from Q3 and revenue growth to converge within about two quarters.

risks_watch: Q2 growth depends on large-deal ramp; most revenue benefit is expected only from Q3.
Encora order intake and growth not quantified; next quarter promised to split it out.
Rising quarterly amortisation (~US$40M/year on customer intangibles) and US$14M MTM hedge loss to be realised over two quarters.
Deflation from AI-driven efficiency; management acknowledged it but did not quantify impact.
Goodwill figure discrepancy between presentation (₹142,651M) and BSE filing (₹120,890M) raised by analyst; management pointed to the filing.
Cloud service-line share fell (~2.7-2.8pp) partly due to reclassification of Encora engineering revenue.
summary.management_tone: Confident and expansive, with management repeatedly calling FY27 an exceptional growth year. Specifics were concrete on integration, G&A and cash flow, but evasive on Encora order intake, standalone AI revenue and Q2 growth quantification.
key_quotes: I am very pleased to share right at the outset that the combined entity in Q1 itself has delivered a reported EBIT of 16.0%.

Our next 12-month executable order book expanded to an all-time high of US$2.23 billion, compared with US$1.55 billion a year ago—an increase of 44.2% year on year, providing strong visibility for the year ahead.
The G&A has actually come down as a percentage of revenue. Just the two companies coming together, the absolute number has gone up.
Saurabh, the $230 million deal that we announced last week, is that part of the deal in this quarter, or will that come in Q2?
Nuuron is the operating system, it is not a platform.
We are not working with Chinese LLMs as Coforge at this point in time.
